line.zh: 邮件、日程、电脑上的文件，都可以交给我。需要你的时候，我再来问你。
line.en: Email, your calendar and files on your computer: hand them to me. I'll come to you only when it needs you.

words.zh: 帮我看看今天有哪些邮件要回
words.en: Which emails today need a reply from me?
Which afternoon this week am I free?

words.zh: Slack 上有没有等我回的？
words.en: Anything on Slack waiting for me?

words.zh: 下个月想去京都，帮我排个行程
words.en: Plan me a few days in Kyoto next month
